meta.title: Field Trip Kit — venue shortlist candidate reference DB
meta.purpose: Reference only for product/content work. Not wired into the live app yet.

priority_scale.1: Must-see / first ~60–90 minutes for a young-kid visit
priority_scale.2: High value — include if energy allows
priority_scale.5: Optional / niche / or explicitly DO NOT promise if notes say absent

confidence_scale.verified: Checked against official or strong primary sources for this research pass
confidence_scale.high: Strong secondary sources / long-standing known exhibits
confidence_scale.medium: Likely but needs official confirmation before publishing as verified

catalog_gap_notes: Orangutan, koala, platypus, Malayan tiger, sun bear appear as high-priority research items but may lack catalog_id photos/cards.
Shared catalog animal blurbs must stay venue-neutral (see trust plan).

venues.name: Taronga Zoo

candidates.name: Platypus
candidates.notes: Harder to see; high wow if visible

venues.visitor_notes: Harbour views + hillside walking. Koala/Aussie animals + Tiger Trek + giraffe skyline views. Hilly — stroller plan. Platypus is rare/special if open.

venues.name: Dublin Zoo
venues.visitor_notes: Phoenix Park. Kaziranga Forest Trail elephants, African Savanna, Gorilla Rainforest, Family Farm for little kids.

venues.name: Ueno Zoo

candidates.name: Red panda
candidates.why_for_visitor: Still a panda-family highlight without giant pandas

candidates.name: Asian elephant (confirm)
candidates.notes: Ueno historically Asian elephants — not African; verify live

candidates.name: Flamingo
candidates.notes: American flamingo noted in zoo news

candidates.name: Giant panda
candidates.notes: ABSENT as of Jan 2026 — do not promise
candidates.why_for_visitor: Was the #1 tourist reason; now gone

venues.visitor_notes: CRITICAL: Giant pandas Xiao Xiao & Lei Lei left Ueno for China late Jan 2026 — Japan has no giant pandas. Do NOT list giant panda. Red pandas still present. Classic city zoo with hills; plan energy.

venues.name: Night Safari

candidates.name: Fishing cat / leopard cat trail animals

venues.visitor_notes: Nocturnal only — evening visit. Tram + walking trails. Different from day zoo.

venues.name: Singapore Zoo

candidates.name: Orangutan (free-ranging / Island)
candidates.notes: No catalog_id yet — highest Singapore priority; consider adding catalog animal

venues.visitor_notes: Open-concept rainforest zoo. Free-ranging orangutans are THE icon. Giraffe feeding popular. Hot/humid — morning visit. Adjacent Night Safari / River Wonders are separate tickets.

venues.name: Edinburgh Zoo

candidates.name: Penguin (Penguin Rock)
candidates.notes: Species may be king/gentoo/others — use penguin find

venues.visitor_notes: Famous for penguins (Penguin Rock / parade traditions). Giant pandas left years ago — do not list. Steep hill.

venues.name: London Zoo

candidates.name: In with the Lemurs / Monkey Valley

venues.visitor_notes: No elephants/rhinos/red pandas at London site — those are at Whipsnade. Strong: Gorilla Kingdom, penguins, tigers, lions, sloths, Madagascar. ~3h city zoo.

venues.name: Natural History Museum

candidates.name: Hintze Hall / whale / main hall icon
Human evolution / Curious Creatures style hands-on
Investigate Centre / family activities if open

venues.visitor_notes: Museum not zoo. Dippy/Hintze Hall, dinosaurs, mammals, Earth halls. Free entry; busy weekends. Kid hunt should be exhibit-based.

venues.name: Dallas Zoo

candidates.name: African elephant
candidates.why_for_visitor: Savanna icon; calf news/adopt messaging active

venues.visitor_notes: Largest zoo in Texas; Giants of the Savanna + Children's Zoo are high ROI for young kids. Giraffe feeding is a real Dallas-specific experience.

venues.name: Beijing Zoo
venues.visitor_notes: Giant pandas remain the #1 tourist reason historically. Still list panda first with high confidence for Beijing specifically; re-check official site before marketing trips.
